name.en: LONGi Hi-MO 6 LR5-54HTB class, 1722 x 1134 x 30 mm, aluminium frame, 108 cells
name.es: Clase LONGi Hi-MO 6 LR5-54HTB, 1722 x 1134 x 30 mm, marco de aluminio, 108 celdas

description.en: LONGi Hi-MO 6 LR5-54HTB 410-430M datasheet (AU version): 1722 x 1134 x 30 mm, 20.8 kg, 108 cells (6 x 18), 3.2 mm coated tempered front glass, single-glass construction, anodized aluminium alloy frame, IP68 junction box with three diodes, static load +5400 / -2400 Pa. Installation manual (LONGi family LR5-54/66/72 HTH/HTB): 8 mounting holes for M8, grounding holes 4.2 mm, clamp overlap 8-11 mm.
description.es: Ficha LONGi Hi-MO 6 LR5-54HTB 410-430M (version AU): 1722 x 1134 x 30 mm, 20,8 kg, 108 celdas (6 x 18), vidrio frontal templado recubierto de 3,2 mm, construccion de vidrio simple, marco de aleacion de aluminio anodizado, caja IP68 con tres diodos, carga estatica +5400 / -2400 Pa. Manual de instalacion (familia LONGi LR5-54/66/72 HTH/HTB): 8 orificios de fijacion M8, puesta a tierra de 4,2 mm, solape de abrazadera 8-11 mm.

typical_use: 54-cell (108 half-cell) aluminium-framed format at 1722 mm; alternative to the steel-framed Maysun 1722 entry.

layers.name: Rear layer
layers.material: single-glass construction printed; rear material not stated

parts.name: Frame: anodized aluminium alloy (section not stated)
parts.geometry_hint: section not stated; see frame_profile_anodized_aluminium family

parts.name: PV output cable: 4 mm2 as printed (text garbled in extract)

ratings.cross_section_note: printed as '4mm''; read as 4 mm2, to be confirmed

parts.name: Mounting holes: 8 for M8 (4 inner, 4 outer), back-side frame
parts.geometry_hint: hole diameter, slot shape and centre distances not stated (S24)

parts.name: Grounding holes, diameter 4.2 mm
parts.geometry_hint: at the edge of the back-side frame, marked with the IEC 61730-1 grounding symbol; not for mounting

parts.name: Drainage holes
parts.geometry_hint: size and position not stated; clamps must not block drain holes

parts.name: PV connector: not stated in the datasheet

geometry.description: Outline from datasheet dimensions. Clamp overlap is printed; clamp distances use a reference edge that the manual does not state, so no clamp zone is positioned.

clamping_zones_mm.formula: 1/4 L - 50 <= D <= 1/4 L + 50 (L as printed; reference edge not stated)
clamping_zones_mm.note: load-table clamp placement formula, LONGi manual p.14
framed module: clamp overlap 8-11 mm with the frame (p.14); corner clamps: length >= 60 mm, overlap >= 9 mm (p.15)

unverified_items: Cell size, busbar count and cell edge length not stated.
Front-glass-only construction; rear material not stated.
Bypass diode current, voltage and type not stated.
Cable cross-section '4mm''' is garbled in the extract; read as 4 mm2, to be confirmed.
Mounting hole diameter, slot shape and centre distances not stated.
Installation manual covers the LR5-54/66/72 HTH/HTB family; the 54HTB model is in that family, not confirmed row by row.
